name: trademe_nz-deals-mcp
description: Trade Me Jobs (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_trademe_nz_consumer_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADEME_NZ_CONSUMER_KEY
platform_mcp_trademe_nz_consumer_key.description: Trade Me API consumer key of your registered application (My Trade Me → Developer options; API access is granted after Trade Me reviews the application).

platform_mcp_trademe_nz_consumer_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADEME_NZ_CONSUMER_SECRET
platform_mcp_trademe_nz_consumer_secret.description: The application's consumer secret: sent as the OAuth 1.0a PLAINTEXT signature '<consumer secret>&' over HTTPS (Trade Me's documented PLAINTEXT workflow).

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /v1/Search/Jobs.json with an application-level OAuth 1.0a PLAINTEXT Authorization header (consumer key + '<consumer secret>&', no member token; rows ≤ 25 without a member token). category is a Trade Me jobs category id. These are employment listings: buyer is the employer (Company); StartDate/EndDate use Trade Me's '/Date(ms)/' JSON format and stay in raw with JobLocation, JobType and pay-range fields. The listing page is https://www.trademe.co.nz/a/jobs/listing/<id>.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /v1/Listings/<ListingId>.json (full body; job listings add Company, ShortDescription and application details in raw).
